name: Laquintasaura
isnote: Conflicting hypotheses make it either an early-diverging ornithischian or a member of Thyreophora (English Wikipedia revision cited); it is placed directly in Ornithischia.
sum: A lightly built Early Jurassic ornithischian from the La Quinta Formation of Venezuela, known from a single bonebed.
wsnote: About 1 m, estimated from the largest femur (90 mm) by comparison with Hypsilophodon, Heterodontosaurus and Hexinlusaurus.
holotype: Not given in the sources used; the material comes from one bonebed in the La Quinta Formation, near La Grita and Seboruco, Táchira, Venezuela.
material: Hundreds of fossil elements representing at least four individuals, all from a single bonebed.
biology: Triangular teeth with striations and sharp denticles may have supported an omnivorous diet, and the animals probably lived in groups on a seasonal alluvial plain where the theropod Tachiraptor also lived.
author: Barrett et al. 2014
